planDepartures: full-agent-negative cannot run 'after controller' on tree 2's planner as the plan placed it: tree 2 is moved to backlog at issue-cap-moves, long before a controller is live, and tree 1 opens the pull request that merges. The one live tree without a pull request while a controller runs is tree 3, held, between its hold and its take-out. So the controller checkpoint now ends at the held notice reaching the controller, full-agent-negative runs on tree 3's planner with the controller live (web_search off in tree 3's workspace, kill, open row naming pod/role/issue/fact, the report-time warning carrying the new incarnation, the tick naming web-search to the controller, the planner answering a nonce, the file removed, kill, present again), and controller-walk carries the former tail (take-out from the operator shell, pods gone, the walk candidate, the tick, the root claim). STAGE4B_SKIP_CONTROLLER skips all three.

summary: Every root architect's and phase worker's session measures the six live capability rows inside Oh My Pi as it boots (after claims/register, beside the jj attribution and the Envoy role claim) and sends the report with claims/ready; the daemon normalises it (never a refusal), keeps the latest report per claim in memory and in claim_capabilities (migration 0036), logs 'capabilities: session reported' and one 'capability <name> is open: <detail>' warning per failing row at report time, renders each live row present/open/unchecked from the sessions whose claim is ready/working/idle at the report's incarnation, shows each claim's report on its view, and names open live rows on the controller's tick. Daemon API contract 18 -> 19 (register promptAgents, ready capabilities, claim view capabilities, no live status). Stage 4b gains a bun stdio MCP fixture and the full-agent and full-agent-negative checkpoints. Round 2 (the tester's fail): the github check reads the role's App login through GraphQL {viewer{login}} instead of REST GET /user, which an App installation token cannot call (403 Resource not accessible by integration); the row's detail names the login it read; the docs, AGENTS and CHANGELOG wording moved with it; the tester's red test (8a113f75) passes unmodified. Round 3 (review round 1, changes requested): Normalize puts every detail on one clean line (control characters out) and floors a failing row's empty detail to 'no detail reported' so the strict state parse never breaks; the claim view's incarnation may be empty; the ready handler hands the report hook the decision context so a disconnecting agent cannot cancel the store write; the MCP probe tears down on an abort that came while the manager was being made; a connection error's URL userinfo is redacted.
unresolved: The 'present' deployment row judged over every live session means one tree whose repository disables a tool (as full-agent-negative does deliberately) opens the row deployment-wide until that process relaunches; the plan lists this as a concern for the architect.

The pod-side proof of the github row ran against the implementer App's token redeemed through today's deployment (the grant shim); under #1843 the same gh reads the token file in GH_CONFIG_DIR — the Stage 4b run at the retargeted head proves that path.
